subject: general
question: Choose the correct** one-word substitute** for: 'Extremely old-fashioned; belonging to a time before the biblical flood'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Antediluvian**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Antediluvian"** means extremely old-fashioned or outdated; it refers to something that existed before the biblical flood. (पुरातन)
 
 
• **Example: **Her ideas about gender roles are so antediluvian that they seem out of place in the modern world.
 
 
• **"Antediluvian"** is derived from the Latin words "ante" (before) and "diluvium" (flood), meaning before the flood. (बाढ़ से पहले का)
 
 
• **Example: **The antediluvian artifacts found in the excavation site amazed the archaeologists.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Antediluvian**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tale** (कहानी): A story, especially one that is imaginative or fictitious.
 
 
• **Example:** The children were captivated by the tale of the brave knight and the dragon.
 
 
• **Obsolete** (प्राचीन या अप्रचलित): No longer in use or outdated.
 
 
• **Example:** Typewriters have become obsolete in the age of computers.
 
 
• **Medieval** (मध्यकालीन): Relating to the Middle Ages, roughly the period from the 5th to the late 15th century.
 
 
• **Example:** The medieval castle stood tall as a reminder of the region's rich history.
 

41:T645,

The correct answer is **option 1.**
